definition-changed.answer: The rule speaks of a declarative (USE) procedure, which is a declarative section in both editions; §2002:4 (entry 4.150) already covers one section ('one or more successive ... sections'), and §2023:3.145 only spells out the single paragraph/section case. Same units, scope unchanged. 'the USE procedure' is the USE BEFORE REPORTING declarative section.

definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 (entry 4.163) defines report as the printed output described in the report section; 2023 drops the entry and the term rests on the RD entry and REPORT clause (§2023:13.18.46.1). In both editions a report is exactly what one RD describes, so the rule governs the same report groups and RDs.
